problems.prompt: A person needs a lens of power -5.5 dioptres for correcting his distant vision. What is the focal length of the lens required for correcting distant vision?
problems.attempt_hint: Seedha P = 1/f formula lagao aur dhyan rahe f meter mein aayega.

solution_steps.narration: Power dioptre (D) mein hai, aur humein focal length chahiye.
focal length ko ek side pe lo.
Values dalo.
Divide karke calculate karo.
Isay cm mein badalna easiest hota hai (multiply by 100).

problems.prompt: The near point of a hypermetropic eye is 1 m. What is the nature and power of the lens required to correct this defect? (Assume normal near point is 25 cm)
problems.attempt_hint: Lens formula lagakar f nikalna hai pehle. Yaad rakhna u aur v dono negative honge.

solution_steps.narration: Hypermetropia mein near point ki shift fix karne ke liye hum u=-25cm lete hain, aur v wahan rakhte hain jo aankh actually dekh sakti hai (-1m).
Values put karte hain minus signs ke sath.
Minus aur minus plus ban jayega.
Power seedhi 1/f hoti hai agar sab kuch meter mein ho.
Positive power hamesha convex lens ko dikhati hai.

problems.prompt: The far point of a myopic person is 80 cm in front of the eye. What is the power of the lens required to correct the problem?
problems.attempt_hint: Myopia mein object ko infinity pe mante hain.

solution_steps.narration: Myopia theek karne ke liye hum lens formula use karte hain jahan u ko negative infinity set karte hain.
Values dalo, dhyan rahe 1/infinity zero hota hai.
Toh focal length f seedha v ke barabar aati hai.
Ab power ka formula use karke D nikal lo.
Solve kar ke exact point dhoondo.

problems.prompt: A student has difficulty reading the blackboard while sitting in the last row. If the furthest he can clearly see is 5 m, calculate the power of the spectacles he needs.
problems.attempt_hint: Kyunki blackboard door hai, problem myopia ki hai. Far point infinity ki jagah 5m ban gaya hai.

solution_steps.narration: Student ko door ki cheez dekhni hai, matlab u ko negative infinity maanna padega.
Virtual image uske far point 5 m par banegi.
Myopia correction ke formula ke mutabik 1/f = 1/v hota hai kyunki 1/infinity is 0.
Seedhe power ka formula apply karte hain.
Fraction ko decimal mein solve kar lo.
